questions.questionText:
Which of the following is irrational?
A) 0.25  B) √2  C) 3/4  D) 0.5

The value of log₁₀(1000) is:
A) 1  B) 2  C) 3  D) 10

The power set of {a,b} contains how many subsets?
A) 2  B) 3  C) 4  D) 5

A factor of x²−9 is:
A) x−9  B) x+9  C) x−3  D) x²+3

The common factor of 6x and 9x² is:
A) 3x  B) 6x²  C) 9x  D) 3x²

The solution of 2x+5=13 is:
A) 3  B) 4  C) 5  D) 9

sin 30° equals:
A) 0  B) 1/2  C) √3/2  D) 1

The value of sin²θ+cos²θ is:
A) 0  B) 1  C) tanθ  D) 2

The slope of the line y=5x+3 is:
A) 3  B) −3  C) 5  D) −5

If the corresponding sides of two triangles are proportional and their corresponding angles are equal, the triangles are:
A) congruent only  B) similar  C) always right-angled  D) unequal

The graph of y=2x+1 is a:
A) circle  B) straight line  C) parabola  D) pair of parallel lines

The locus of points equidistant from the endpoints of a segment is its:
A) angle bisector  B) perpendicular bisector  C) median  D) altitude

The arithmetic mean of 2, 4 and 6 is:
A) 3  B) 4  C) 5  D) 6

The probability of getting a head when a fair coin is tossed is:
A) 0  B) 1/4  C) 1/2  D) 1
Express 0.375 as a fraction in lowest terms.
Classify √49 and √7 as rational or irrational.
Evaluate log₂(32).
Find the characteristic of log₁₀(0.00056).
Find A∪B if A={a,b,c} and B={b,d}.
Write the power set of {p,q}.
Factorize x²+5x+6.
Factorize 4a²−25.
Solve 3(x−2)=12.
Convert 150° into radians.
Find the arc length when r=6 cm and θ=π/3 radians.
Evaluate 2cos(π/6)sin(π/6).
Find the distance between (0,3) and (−2,−4).
Find the slope joining (3,−2) and (2,7).
Write the equation of the horizontal line through (7,−9).
Two similar triangles have corresponding sides in ratio 2:3. Find the ratio of their areas.
questions.answerText: Area ratio is the square of side ratio: 2²:3²=4:9.

questions.questionText: If two corresponding angles of two triangles are equal, and their third angles are also equal, what can be concluded?
questions.answerText: The triangles are equiangular and therefore similar.

questions.questionText: The sides of two similar triangles are in ratio 3:5. If a side of the smaller is 9 cm, find the corresponding larger side.
Find y when x=3 in y=2x−1.
Give two points that lie on y=x+2.
Define the perpendicular bisector of a line segment.
questions.answerText: A line through the segment's midpoint and perpendicular to it.

questions.questionText: What is the locus of points at a fixed distance from a fixed point?
questions.answerText: A circle centred at the fixed point with the given radius.

questions.questionText: Find the arithmetic mean of 4, 6, 8 and 10.
Find the mode of 3, 5, 5, 6, 7, 5, 8.
questions.answerText: The mode is 5, as it occurs most often.

questions.questionText: Find the median of 2, 4, 7, 9, 12.
A fair die is rolled. Find the probability of getting an even number.
Define sample space for a single coin toss.
questions.answerText: S={H,T}, the set of all possible outcomes.

questions.questionText: Q5 — (a) Simplify √50+√8. (b) Solve log₁₀x=−2.
Q6 — (a) For A={1,2,3,4} and B={3,4,5}, find A∪B and A∩B. (b) Factorize x⁴−5x²+4.
Q7 — (a) Solve 2x−3≤7 and represent the solution interval. (b) Prove (tanθ+cotθ)²=sec²θ cosec²θ.
questions.answerText: (a) 2x≤10, x≤5; interval (−∞,5]. (b) tanθ+cotθ=(sin²θ+cos²θ)/(sinθcosθ)=1/(sinθcosθ); squaring gives sec²θ cosec²θ.

questions.questionText: Q8 — (a) Find the distance between A(0,2) and B(3,6), and state the slope of AB. (b) Two similar triangles have corresponding sides 6 cm and 9 cm. If the area of the smaller is 24 cm², find the area of the larger.
questions.answerText: (a) Distance=√[(3−0)²+(6−2)²]=5; slope=(6−2)/(3−0)=4/3. (b) Side ratio=2:3, area ratio=4:9; larger area=24×9/4=54 cm².

questions.questionText: Q9 — (a) For 4, 6, 6, 8, 10, find mean, median and mode. (b) A bag has 3 red and 2 blue balls. Find the probability of selecting a blue ball.
Which number is rational? A) √3  B) π  C) 0.125  D) √5
If log₃ 81 = x, then x is: A) 2  B) 3  C) 4  D) 9
The factorization of x²−16 is: A) (x−4)²  B) (x+4)²  C) (x−4)(x+4)  D) x(x−16)
The solution of 5x−7=18 is: A) 3  B) 4  C) 5  D) 6
cos 60° equals: A) 0  B) 1/2  C) √3/2  D) 1
The slope of a vertical line is: A) 0  B) 1  C) −1  D) undefined
If two triangles are equiangular, they are: A) congruent  B) similar  C) always isosceles  D) always right-angled
The y-intercept of y=3x−4 is: A) 3  B) −4  C) 4  D) −3
The locus of a point at a fixed distance r from O is: A) a line  B) a circle  C) a ray  D) a pair of lines
questions.answerText: B) A circle with centre O and radius r.

questions.questionText: The mode of 2, 3, 3, 4, 5 is: A) 2  B) 3  C) 4  D) 5
A fair die is rolled. P(getting a number greater than 4) is: A) 1/6  B) 1/3  C) 1/2  D) 2/3
Express 0.272727… as a fraction in lowest terms.
Rationalize 1/(√5+√2).
Evaluate log₅(1/25).
Use the product law to expand log₁₀(6x), where x>0.
If n(A)=18, n(B)=12 and n(A∩B)=5, find n(A∪B).
For A={1,2,3,4} and B={2,4}, find A∩B and A−B.
Factorize 3x²+12x.
Factorize x²−7x+12.
Solve 4x+3<19.
Convert 225° into radians.
If sin θ=3/5 and θ is acute, find cos θ.
Find the midpoint of A(−2,5) and B(4,−1).
Find the equation of the line with slope 2 passing through (1,3).
Two similar triangles have side ratio 4:7. Find the ratio of their perimeters.
questions.answerText: The perimeter ratio equals the corresponding side ratio: 4:7.

questions.questionText: Similar triangles have side ratio 2:5. If the larger area is 100 cm², find the smaller area.
Find the x-intercept of y=2x−6.
Find y=−x+4 when x=0 and x=3.
questions.answerText: When x=0, y=4; when x=3, y=1.

questions.questionText: A point P is equidistant from A and B. What geometric locus contains P?
questions.answerText: P lies on the perpendicular bisector of segment AB.

questions.questionText: How many intersection points can two distinct circles have if they cross each other?
Find the range of 4, 7, 9, 12, 15.
Find the median of 2, 5, 8, 10, 13, 17.
A box contains 4 green and 6 yellow counters. Find P(not green).
A letter is chosen at random from MATHS. Find P(choosing a vowel).
questions.answerText: Only A is a vowel; probability=1/5.

questions.questionText: (a) Simplify √72−√18. (b) Express 0.0004 in standard form.
(a) Evaluate log₂(64). (b) Solve log₁₀x=3 for x.
(a) For U={1,2,3,4,5,6}, A={1,2,3} and B={3,4,5}, find A∪B and A∩B. (b) Find the number of subsets of a set with 3 elements.
(a) Factorize x²+2x−15. (b) Factorize 9a²−4b².
(a) Solve 3x+5=2x+14. (b) Solve 2x−1≤9 and write the solution interval.
(a) Convert 120° into radians. (b) Evaluate sin²30°+cos²30°.
(a) Find the distance between (1,2) and (5,5). (b) Find the slope of the line joining these points.
(a) Find the slope and y-intercept of 3x+2y=8. (b) Find y when x=−2.
(a) Two similar triangles have corresponding sides 5 cm and 8 cm. Find the scale factor. (b) If the smaller perimeter is 30 cm, find the larger perimeter.
(a) Find the mean of 5, 7, 8, 10, 10. (b) Find the median and mode of the same data.
(a) A fair die is rolled. Find the probability of getting a prime number. (b) A bag contains 5 white and 3 black balls. Find P(black).
(a) Describe the compass-and-ruler construction of the perpendicular bisector of AB=8 cm. (b) State the locus of points equidistant from A and B.
questions.answerText: (a) Draw AB=8 cm. With radius greater than 4 cm, draw arcs above and below AB from A. With the same radius, draw arcs from B to intersect them at P and Q. Join P and Q; it is the perpendicular bisector of AB. (b) The locus of all points equidistant from A and B is the perpendicular bisector of AB.

questions.questionText: Which is a rational number? (A) √7 (B) π (C) −5/8 (D) √3
questions.answerText: C) −5/8. It is a ratio of two integers.

questions.questionText: Express 0.375 as a fraction in simplest form and classify it.
Simplify √72−√18+√8.
log₁₀(1000) equals: (A) 2 (B) 3 (C) 10 (D) 100
Evaluate log₇(343).
Use laws of logarithms to simplify log₃(9)+log₃(27)−log₃(3).
For A={a,b,c} and B={b,c,d}, find A∪B and A−B.
Let f(x)=2x−3. Find f(−2), f(0) and the value of x when f(x)=7.
The factorization of x²−9 is: (A) (x−9)(x+1) (B) (x−3)(x+3) (C) (x−3)² (D) (x+9)(x−1)
Factorize 6x²+9x.
Simplify (x²−16)/(x²+8x+16), stating excluded values.
The solution of 3x−5=10 is: (A) 3 (B) 5 (C) 10 (D) 15
Solve and represent on a number line: 2x−3≤7.
questions.answerText: 2x≤10, so x≤5; closed dot at 5 and shade left.

questions.questionText: In a right triangle, sin θ is: (A) adjacent/hypotenuse (B) opposite/hypotenuse (C) opposite/adjacent (D) hypotenuse/opposite
questions.answerText: B) Opposite side divided by hypotenuse.

questions.questionText: If sin θ=3/5 for an acute angle, find cos θ.
questions.answerText: Opposite=3, hypotenuse=5; adjacent=4 by Pythagoras, so cos θ=4/5.

questions.questionText: A ladder 10 m long makes an angle of 60° with the ground. Find the height reached, using sin 60°=√3/2.
Find the distance between P(1,2) and Q(4,6).
Find the equation of the line through (0,3) with slope 2.
The negation of the statement '7 is an even number' is: (A) 7 is odd (B) 7 is even (C) 7 is prime (D) 7 is composite
questions.answerText: A) 7 is not even; equivalently, 7 is odd.

questions.questionText: Write the converse of: 'If a number is divisible by 4, then it is even.'
questions.answerText: If a number is even, then it is divisible by 4.

questions.questionText: Construct a truth table for p∧q and state when it is true.
questions.answerText: p∧q is true only when both p and q are true; rows TT, TF, FT, FF give T,F,F,F.

questions.questionText: Corresponding angles of similar polygons are: (A) unequal (B) equal (C) supplementary always (D) right angles
Two similar triangles have corresponding sides 6 cm and 9 cm. Find the scale factor from the first to the second.
Two similar triangles have side ratio 2:3. If the smaller triangle has perimeter 24 cm, find the larger perimeter.
questions.answerText: Perimeters have the same ratio; larger=24×3/2=36 cm.

questions.questionText: The graph of y=3 is a: (A) vertical line (B) horizontal line (C) parabola (D) circle
questions.answerText: B) Horizontal line parallel to x-axis.

questions.questionText: Complete a table for y=2x+1 when x=−1,0,2.
Draw the graph of y=x−2 using three points and state its intercepts.
questions.answerText: Points (0,−2),(2,0),(4,2) lie on the line; y-intercept −2 and x-intercept 2.

questions.questionText: The locus of points at a fixed distance from a point is a: (A) line (B) circle (C) angle bisector (D) parallel line
questions.answerText: B) Circle centred at the fixed point.

questions.questionText: State the locus of points equidistant from two intersecting straight lines.
questions.answerText: The pair of angle bisectors of the angles formed by the lines.

questions.questionText: Describe construction of a 60° angle using compass and straightedge.
questions.answerText: Draw ray AB; with centre A draw an arc meeting AB at C; same radius from C cuts arc at D; join AD. Angle DAB=60°.

questions.questionText: The mean of 2,4,6,8 is: (A) 4 (B) 5 (C) 6 (D) 8
Find the median of 3,9,4,7,5.
A class has frequencies 2,3,5 for values 1,2,3. Find the mean.
A fair coin is tossed once. Probability of tail is: (A) 0 (B) 1/4 (C) 1/2 (D) 1
questions.answerText: C) One favourable outcome out of two.

questions.questionText: A die is rolled. Find the probability of obtaining a number greater than 4.
A bag contains 4 red, 3 blue and 5 green balls. Find the probability of selecting neither red nor green.
questions.answerText: Only blue is favourable; total=12, probability=3/12=1/4.

questions.questionText: A shopkeeper buys an item for Rs. 800 and sells it for Rs. 920. Find the profit percentage.
Convert 25°C to Fahrenheit using F=(9/5)C+32.
Expand logₐ(x²y/z) for positive x,y,z.
If log₁₀2=0.3010, find log₁₀20.
If R={(1,2),(2,4),(3,6)}, write the domain and range.
For f(x)=x²−1, find f(−2), f(0), f(3), and state the range for domain {−2,0,3}.
Simplify √(49x²), assuming x≥0.
Factorize x⁴−16.
Does (2,1) satisfy x+y≤4 and x≥0?
Find the corner points of the feasible region x≥0, y≥0, x+y≤6, and evaluate P=2x+3y at each.
A line of sight looking upward from the horizontal is called the angle of what?
From a point 20 m from a tower, its top subtends 30° elevation. Find the height, using tan30°=1/√3.
Find the midpoint of the segment joining (−4,2) and (6,8).
Show that A(0,0), B(4,0), C(4,3) form a right triangle and find its area.
questions.answerText: AB=4, BC=3, AC=5; AB⊥BC, so right-angled at B; area=1/2×4×3=6 square units.

questions.questionText: Write the negation of: 'Every prime number is odd.'
questions.answerText: There exists at least one prime number that is not odd.

questions.questionText: Let p be true and q be false. Find the truth values of p∨q and p→q.
questions.answerText: p∨q is true; p→q is false.

questions.questionText: Find the sum of interior angles of a hexagon.
Each exterior angle of a regular polygon is 30°. Find the number of sides and each interior angle.
For y=2ˣ, find y when x=0,1,2.
Estimate the gradient of y=x² at x=2 using points x=1.9 and x=2.1.
What locus represents points 5 cm from a fixed point O?
questions.answerText: A circle of radius 5 cm centred at O.

questions.questionText: Two roads are represented by intersecting lines l and m. Describe the locus of points equidistant from both roads.
questions.answerText: The two angle bisectors of the angles formed by l and m.

questions.questionText: A student scores 70 in a test weighted 40% and 90 in a test weighted 60%. Find the weighted mean.
Find the weighted mean of values 10,20,30 with respective weights 1,2,3.
A fair die is rolled 120 times. Find the expected number of sixes.
A machine produces an item with probability 0.04 of being defective. In 500 items, find the expected number of defectives.
